scope: In-process Ganache31340/shanghai only. Real S0ULUniversalReader, S0ULAnalysisFacts and S0ULAnalysisCodec; local adversarial target fixtures. No public RPC, transactions or model-quality claim.

cases.name: reader identity, schema identity and constructor pins fail closed
zero, unfunded no-code and funded no-code addresses are accepted with exact full-width native balance
contract evidence preserves exact code hash, balance, block counter and observation timestamp
reported interface masks require canonical ERC165 and map directly to the model input
ownership, implementation and asset classify unavailable, zero and nonzero separately without truncating dirty addresses
pause has unavailable, false and true states and rejects noncanonical boolean data
supply availability is independent of zero or positive value and preserves all uint256 bits
scalar return bombs, truncation, revert, gas exhaustion and attempted writes cannot poison feature classes
pool compatibility requires canonical reserves and live distinct asset contract addresses
pool zero reserves, uint112 and uint32 boundaries are distinguished and out-of-range words are rejected
pool malformed sizes, bombs, reverts, exhausted gas and write attempts are unavailable rather than fabricated
opcode features are exact structural flags, skip PUSH data and retain incomplete-scan evidence
cross-checks reject reader target, native balance, code identity, mask, clock or block inconsistencies
capture derives prompt internally, ignores trailing ABI data, rejects insufficient gas and fits bounded adversarial scan
strict word codec: domain, schema and all output words match the frozen Python vocabulary
strict word codec: exact generated words round trip without selecting or replacing content
strict word codec: missing EOS, repeated or middle specials, input IDs, padding and unassigned vocabulary IDs fail closed
strict word codec: output length counts EOS and enforces the thirty-two-token generation boundary
